question: What are the 5 billing countries with the most revenue? Show the country and revenue, highest first.
sql: SELECT BillingCountry AS country, SUM(Total) AS revenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5;

question: What was the total revenue in each year? Order by year.
sql: SELECT YEAR(InvoiceDate) AS year, SUM(Total) AS revenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY YEAR(InvoiceDate) ORDER BY year;

question: What is the average body mass of each species?
sql: SELECT species, AVG(body_mass_g) AS avg_body_mass FROM penguins GROUP BY species;

question: Which island has the most penguins?
sql: SELECT island FROM penguins GROUP BY island ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which 5 countries had the largest population in 2023? Show the name and population, largest first.
sql: SELECT c.name, cs.population FROM countries c JOIN country_stats cs ON c.iso3 = cs.iso3 WHERE cs.year = 2023 ORDER BY cs.population DESC LIMIT 5;

question: What was the average fertility rate in each region in 2023?
sql: SELECT c.region, AVG(cs.fertility_rate) AS avg_fertility FROM country_stats cs JOIN countries c ON cs.iso3 = c.iso3 WHERE cs.year = 2023 GROUP BY c.region;
rows: Middle East, North Africa, Afghanistan & Pakistan
